name: City
description: Urban areas like cities are defined by the humans that live in them and the environments that they create. Some Pokémon only can live parts of their lives in cities, while others happily inhabit walkways, alleys, or even homes as pets or pests. Normal-, Psychic-, Fighting-, and Ghost-type Pokémon often coexist alongside people, while Poison-types even thrive on the waste that we create.
